tools.name: search_vibe
tools.title: Vibe Search
tools.description: Preferred natural-language ('vibe') property search. Pass the user's request as prose and the engine matches on lifestyle, mood, proximity, and soft preferences via embeddings + LLM reasoning. Healthy runs return source-grounded match reasons and a 0-100 request-fit score (not a probability); degraded runs explicitly omit ranking claims. Every sourced result identifies and links the original agency listing and states its latest catalogue re-sighting time. The response's understanding block states what was understood; wishes in understanding.notChecked are not confirmed for any returned home. If the requested place cannot be resolved safely, it returns no listings plus a machine-readable unanswerable reason instead of substituting unrelated homes.

query.description: Natural-language description of what the user wants, in their own words — e.g. "quiet 2-bed near Kirchberg with a balcony under €2000" or "bright family house with a garden, short commute to Belval, energy class A". Lifestyle, vibe, proximity, and soft preferences all work here.

intent.description: Whether to search rentals or properties for sale (default: "rent")

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

limit.description: Number of results to return (max 50, default 20)

followUp.description: A change to the previous search or a question about its results, in the user’s own words — e.g. "cheaper", "like #2 but with a garden", "which one has parking?". Send it with the `brief` from the previous response (`session.brief`) and the same `query`. A question leaves the search unchanged and comes back as `followUp.reply`.

brief.description: The `session.brief` object from the previous search_vibe response, passed back unchanged to continue that search. Without `followUp` it replays the same search without re-reading the request.

shownListingIds.description: Ids of the listings you showed the user, in the order shown, so "#2" or "the second one" in `followUp` points at the right home.

includePhotos.description: Attach thumbnail photos of the top results as image content blocks (default: true). Set false for a lean text-only response.

unknown.description: Why each missingFields entry is unknown. not_in_search_result means get_listing may know it.

total.description: Exact number of listing objects returned in this response; not the number of matches in the market.

excludedUnprovenCount.description: Upstream rows omitted because public facts could not prove every requested hard filter.

understanding.description: What the engine understood from the request. notChecked lists wishes no returned home is confirmed to have.

tools.name: search_rentals

tools.description: Search active Luxembourg rentals by location, rooms, area, property type, positive-evidence amenities, advertised base rent, or a separate strict confirmed monthly-obligation ceiling. The strict ceiling excludes listings when required recurring charges, fees, evidence, or source freshness are incomplete. Returned counts include explicit completeness metadata; every sourced result links the original agency listing and states its latest catalogue re-sighting time.
